question: A novel based on the story of a family named ‘Fasting, Feasting’ was written by whom among the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anita Desai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Anita Desai** is an acclaimed Indian author known for her significant contributions to Indian literature.
 
• She has been shortlisted for the Booker Prize three times for her novels **Clear Light of Day** (1980), **In Custody** (1984), and **Fasting, Feasting** (1999).
 
• Anita Desai is a member of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, reflecting her recognition as a writer of great merit.
 
• Her writing often explores themes of personal and cultural identity, the inner lives of women, and the complexities of human relationships.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anita Desai**

 
 
• Anita Desai was born on June 24, 1937, in Mussoorie, India. She is of German and Bengali descent and writes in English.
 
• She has received numerous awards for her work, including the Sahitya Akademi Award, the Padma Shri, and the Padma Bhushan.
 
• Desai's body of work includes novels, short stories, and children's books, and she is regarded as one of the foremost Indian writers in English.
 
• Her novel **In Custody** was adapted into a film by Merchant Ivory Productions, directed by Ismail Merchant.
 
 
 
• **Other Important Authors and Their Works**
 
 
• **Arundhati Roy**
 
 
• Arundhati Roy is an Indian author best known for her novel **The God of Small Things**, which won the Man Booker Prize for Fiction in 1997.
 
• She is also a political activist involved in environmental and human rights causes.
 
 
 
• **Arvind Adiga**
 
 
• Arvind Adiga is an Indian author and journalist. His debut novel, **The White Tiger**, won the Man Booker Prize in 2008.
 
• His work often addresses issues of social inequality and economic disparity in India.
 
 
 
• **Kiran Desai**
 
 
• Kiran Desai is an Indian author and the daughter of Anita Desai. She won the Man Booker Prize in 2006 for her novel **The Inheritance of Loss**.
 
• Her writing explores themes of globalization, migration, and the clash of cultures.
